items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: This is where Herb Pomeroy and all those people taught, and John LaPorta and all, they teach up there.

ctx.x: Yeah. He says, “we don’t normally do this.” Probably the dean. But he says, “we understand your situation.” This is where Herb Pomeroy and all those people taught, and John LaPorta and all, they teach up there. And he says, “we don’t normally do this but we understand your situation” so they gave me the money back. And I took the money and applied it toward my room.
Did you decide not to go there because you just couldn’t afford it?
